summary: Retested the iteration_13 fixes. Backend: the new tests/test_date_history_fixes.py passed 6/6 and the regression tests/test_date_history.py passed 11/11 (both earlier failures now pass). Confirmed: (a) a PUT with '' surgery_date/documents_sent_date creates no audit entry and nothing in /date-changes/recent. Assigned and then moved dates show up correctly under both dates. (b) /audit/date/{date} is location-scoped: jan gets an empty list for a Medicus patient, still sees his Pro-Familia patient, and admin sees everything. (c) The 'Lokalizacja' audit field stores location names for both a PUT location change and a slot assign. Frontend: PatientAuditLog refreshes after the edit modal is saved (2 -> 3 entries, no reload), and null/empty old values render as 'brak'. DashboardDayModal closes on Escape. The /calendar 'Historia tego terminu' shows 'Przeniesiono na ten termin (z 2027-05-05)' on 7 May and 'Przeniesiono z tego terminu (na 2027-05-07)' on 5 May. One minor issue: the /calendar day modal (in CalendarPage) does NOT close on Escape, because it has no keydown handler. iteration_13 said this worked. All test data was cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape does not close the /calendar day modal: there is no keydown handler in CalendarPage.jsx (only DashboardDayModal has one). Reproduced twice. The modal stayed open after Esc, including when focus was on the date-history toggle.

action_items: Add Escape-to-close to the CalendarPage day modal, using the same useEffect keydown listener as DashboardDayModal
critical_code_review_comments: patients.update_patient: the guard '(old or None) == (new or None)' also hides real changes from 0/False to None for non-numeric fields. That is acceptable, but note that a list [] -> None change is silently skipped as well.
audit.get_recent_date_changes still applies the location filter after to_list(limit*3), so the feed for a non-global user can be truncated (carried over from iteration_13).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; /calendar Esc not handled)
